::: {#sol-batch-of-one}

A minibatch of one image has $\mu_j = z_{1j}$ and $\sigma_j^2 = 0$,
so every normalized [pre-activation](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-pre-activation) would be 0,
whatever the image.
The prediction would not depend on the image at all.

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
try:
    _ = batch_norm(pre[:1])
except ValueError as error:
    batch_of_one_error = str(error)
print(batch_of_one_error)
_ = batch_norm.eval()
one_image_output = batch_norm(pre[:1])
print(one_image_output.shape)
```

In training mode,
`nn.BatchNorm1d` refuses a minibatch of one:
"`r py$batch_of_one_error`".
In evaluation mode it uses its running averages instead,
so it accepts a single image.
Evaluation mode is what makes predictions use the running averages,
so `train()` calls `net.eval()` before it computes the test [accuracy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-accuracy).

:::
